lowConfidence.claim: OSPF cost formula C = max(1, ⌊R / B⌋) uses truncation (floor)
lowConfidence.reason: Cisco FAQ (9237-9) states reference/interface bandwidth and a 100 Mbit/s default; truncation is inferred from Cisco-quoted values (64 kbit/s → 1562, T1 → 64) rather than an explicit statement. Other vendors may round differently.

lowConfidence.claim: Dijkstra example: 1,000 routers and 3,000 links ≈ 40,000 basic steps
lowConfidence.reason: Order-of-magnitude illustration of O((V + E) log V) with constants ignored; labelled 'on the order of'. Not a measurement.

lowConfidence.claim: Facebook outage lasted about six hours
lowConfidence.reason: Facebook's engineering post gives no duration; Cloudflare's timeline (routes withdrawn ~15:40 UTC, DNS restored ~21:20 UTC) gives roughly 5.5–6 hours.

lowConfidence.claim: hash polarisation / resilient hashing / load imbalance definitions cite RFC 2992
lowConfidence.reason: RFC 2992 analyses hash-threshold ECMP disruption but does not name polarisation or resilient hashing; definitions are standard practice but the cited source only partly supports them.
